label: Live UDP: asymmetric delay
description: Both datagrams traverse the relay; A is forwarded earlier than B.

label: Live UDP: induced reordering
description: A is sent first but the relay delays it long enough for B to arrive first.

label: Live UDP: selective drop
description: The relay drops B; A contributes one-sided evidence at close.

label: Live UDP: B misses deadline
description: B is forwarded after close and is logged as late rather than assigned a finite penalty.

label: Live UDP: disconnect then recovery
description: A first round is dropped; a second race is emitted after recovery and certified from that capture.
